changes.title: Filter uncommon text values
changes.text: Multi-value text filters now offer full-list typing even when common suggestions are available, so uncommon recorded values remain reachable.

changes.title: Long multi-value lists
changes.text: The full-list text input no longer truncates multi-value filters at forty characters; ordinary suggestion lists remain compact.

changes.title: Native menu help
changes.text: Statistics picker help now uses SPD's grey button styling while retaining its existing explanation popup.

changes.title: Uncommon-value picker regression
changes.text: Android checks now open full-list input, verify a value outside sixty suggestions and apply a longer six-value filter.

changes.title: Verification and execution records
changes.text: Recorded the preceding cache build's checks, continued audit evidence and actual scheduler limitations.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I kept the compact suggestions while restoring a way to enter uncommon values and longer lists. Query calculations and genuine history remain unchanged.
